title: com.matrixmedia.subscription_proof
description: State event proving a user's active subscription to a creator's tier. State key is the subscriber's fully-qualified Matrix user ID (e.g. '@bob:example.org'). When a subscription expires or is cancelled, the bot sets content to {} to clear the state.

oneOf.description: Active subscription proof. All required fields must be present for a valid subscription.

subscriber_user_id.description: Fully-qualified Matrix user ID of the subscriber (e.g. '@bob:example.org'). Must match the state_key.

creator_user_id.description: Fully-qualified Matrix user ID of the creator this subscription is for (e.g. '@alice:example.org').

tier_level.description: Numeric tier level the subscriber is enrolled in (1-5).

tier_name.description: Human-readable name of the subscription tier (e.g. 'Gold').

valid_until_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the subscription expires. Clients should treat the subscription as inactive after this time.

mm_server_url.description: Base URL of the MatrixMedia server that issued this subscription proof.

version.description: Schema version. Must be 1 for this version of the event schema.

oneOf.description: Cleared state. An empty object signals that the subscription has expired or been cancelled.
